text: Select: ChEMBL ID (chembl_id), compound name (pref_name), maximum clinical phase (max_phase), molecule type (molecule_type), canonical SMILES (canonical_smiles). Source: Molecule dictionary (molecule_dictionary) and compound structures (compound_structures). Join: Molecule dictionary to compound records (compound_records) on molregno, then to documents (docs) on doc_id. Left join compound structures on molregno. Filter: Documents where chembl_id equals 'CHEMBL1130277'. Sort: ChEMBL ID ascending. Limit: None.
